title: Root coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-concrete-coefficients]. For a scheme $X$ and integer $N$, let the root comparison be the unique isomorphism from the existing abelian roots-of-unity sheaf to the section-defined pro-etale root sheaf whose map on every sheafification generator is the same root. Pullback of roots is the sectionwise pullback, conjugated by these comparisons. Tensor it with the canonical coefficient inverse-image isomorphism to obtain the raw finite integral root pullback. An internal module isomorphism is pull-normalized when, after forgetting scalars and using the canonical inverse-image/forget comparison, its map equals that raw root pullback. Existence and uniqueness of the generator-normalized root comparison are part of this interface.

source.place: Coefficient, functor, counit and normalization clauses; coordinate interface TransportRoot

proof.text: Use existsUnique_proEtaleRootsOfUnitySections to identify every section of the kernel sheaf with a root of unity. Compose with the canonical ULift additive equivalence. The inclusion into the units sheaf and its naturality show that these additive isomorphisms commute with restriction: apply the inclusion, use its normalized section formula on both sides, and remove ULift. Thus they form a natural isomorphism from the underlying kernel presheaf to rootsOfUnityPresheaf.

Apply presheafToSheaf to the inverse of this natural isomorphism and compose with the inverse of sheafificationIso of the kernel sheaf. Naturality of toSheafify and its inverse identity on a sheaf show that the resulting sheaf isomorphism sends each generator to the same root. This uses only the sheafification adjunction, not an invertibility assumption on N.

For any other normalized isomorphism, its underlying morphism agrees on all sheafification generators, since the section equivalence is injective. The universal property sheafify_hom_ext gives equality of the underlying presheaf maps, Sheaf.hom_ext gives equality of sheaf maps, and Iso.ext gives equality of isomorphisms. The remaining coordinate definitions are unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Section 03PK (section-kummer), definition of roots as sections of units; Tag 00WH (proposition-sheafification-adjoint), the sheafification universal property. The sectionwise naturality and universal-property argument is formalized by Q4, 2026-10-26.
